items.name: bQ_andb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_andb : forall a b, bQ (andb a b) == (bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb : forall b, bQ (negb b) == (1 - bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_orb
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_orb : forall a b, 
  bQ (orb a b) == (bQ a + bQ b - bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bool_dist_le
items.statement:
Definition bool_dist_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool,
    l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)) <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_embed
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_embed : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool),
  bool_dist_le (embed g) 0.

items.name: l1_norm_ext
items.statement:
Lemma l1_norm_ext : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (forall m, F m == G m) -> l1_norm F == l1_norm G.

items.name: bool_dist_le_mono
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_le_mono : forall n (F : MV n) (d d' : Q),
  bool_dist_le F d -> d <= d' -> bool_dist_le F d'.

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb : forall n (F G : MV n) (dF : Q),
  bool_dist_le F dF ->
  bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (dF + l1_norm G).

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb_r
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb_r : forall n (F G : MV n) (dG : Q),
  bool_dist_le G dG ->
  bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (l1_norm F + dG).

items.name: bool_dist_wrt
items.statement:
Definition bool_dist_wrt {n} (F : MV n) (g : Corner n -> bool) : Q :=
  l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)).

items.name: bool_dist_le_iff
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_le_iff : forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q),
  bool_dist_le F d <-> exists g, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_self
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_self : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool),
  bool_dist_wrt (embed g) g == 0.

items.name: mv_sub_add_split
items.statement:
Lemma mv_sub_add_split : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool) (m : Mask n),
  mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG)) m
  == mv_add (mv_sub F (embed gF)) (mv_sub G (embed gG)) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_add
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool),
  l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG)))
  <= bool_dist_wrt F gF + bool_dist_wrt G gG.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_ext_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G1 G2 : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    (forall m, G1 m == G2 m) ->
    mv_gp sq F G1 U == mv_gp sq F G2 U.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_ext_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F1 F2 G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    (forall m, F1 m == F2 m) ->
    mv_gp sq F1 G U == mv_gp sq F2 G U.

items.name: Qeq_minus_l
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_minus_l : forall a b c : Q, a + b == c -> a == c - b.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_sub_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G H) m == (mv_gp sq F G m - mv_gp sq F H m)%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_sub_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_gp sq (mv_sub F G) H m == (mv_gp sq F H m - mv_gp sq G H m)%Q.

items.name: gp_error_split
items.statement:
Lemma gp_error_split : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G eF eG : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq eF eG) m
  == mv_add (mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G eG)) (mv_gp sq (mv_sub F eF) eG) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_gp
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_gp : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n)
  (gF gG : Corner n -> bool),
  (forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) ->
  l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq (embed gF) (embed gG)))
  <= l1_norm F * bool_dist_wrt G gG
   + bool_dist_wrt F gF * l1_norm (embed gG).

items.name: BoolFormula
items.statement:
Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type :=
  | BVar   : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n                          
  | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n                             
  | BAnd   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BOr    : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BNot   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: eval_bf
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_bf {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i     => match Vector.nth c i with Pos => true | Neg => false end
  | BConst b   => b
  | BAnd p q   => andb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BOr p q    => orb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BNot p     => negb (eval_bf p c)
  end.

items.name: translate
items.statement:
Fixpoint translate {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : GA_expr n :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i       => Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i))
  | BConst true  => Scalar 1
  | BConst false => Scalar 0
  | BAnd p q     => Conv (translate p) (translate q)             
  | BNot p       => Add (Scalar 1) (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (translate p))
  | BOr p q      => Add (Add (translate p) (translate q))
                         (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (Conv (translate p) (translate q)))
  end.

items.name: mask_xor_self
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_self : forall n (A : Mask n), mask_xor A A = mask_empty.

items.name: xorb_eq_false_implies_eq
items.statement: Lemma xorb_eq_false_implies_eq : forall a b : bool, xorb a b = false -> a = b.

items.name: VectorDef_nth_const

  forall (A : Type) (a : A) n (i : Fin.t n),
    VectorDef.nth (Vector.const a n) i = a.

items.name: mask_xor_eq_empty_iff
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_eq_empty_iff : forall n (A B : Mask n),
  mask_xor A B = mask_empty -> A = B.

items.name: sumQ_swap
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_swap :
  forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B -> Q) (la : list A) (lb : list B),
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => f a b) lb)) la)
    == sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => f a b) la)) lb).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum
items.statement:
Definition corner_walsh_sum {n} (m1 m2 : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' m1 s * chi' m2 s)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_via_xor
items.statement:
Lemma corner_walsh_sum_via_xor :
  forall n (m1 m2 : Mask n),
    corner_walsh_sum m1 m2
    == sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_xor m1 m2) s) (all_corners n)).

items.name: chi_corner_sum_empty
items.statement:
Lemma chi_corner_sum_empty :
  forall n,
    sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_empty (n:=n)) s) (all_corners n))
    == pow2 n.

items.name: Qmax
items.statement:
Definition Qmax (a b : Q) : Q :=
  if Qle_bool a b then b else a.

items.name: Qmax_l
items.statement: Lemma Qmax_l : forall a b, a <= Qmax a b.

items.name: Qmax_r
items.statement: Lemma Qmax_r : forall a b, b <= Qmax a b.

items.name: list_Qmax
items.statement:
Fixpoint list_Qmax (xs : list Q) : Q :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: tl => Qmax x (list_Qmax tl)
  end.

items.name: max_l1_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_l1_during {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1
  | Scalar c  => Qabs c
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      max_l1_during sq e1 + max_l1_during sq e2
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  end.

items.name: l1_eval_le_max_l1_during
items.statement:
Lemma l1_eval_le_max_l1_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    l1_norm (eval_expr sq e) <= max_l1_during sq e.

items.name: dist_to
items.statement:
Definition dist_to {n} (F : MV n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Q :=
  bool_dist_wrt F f.

items.name: boolish_le
items.statement:
Definition boolish_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d.

items.name: max_booldist_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_booldist_during {n}
  (sq : Vector.t Q n)
  (f  : Corner n -> bool)
  (e  : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _  => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Scalar _ => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) f)
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  end.

items.name: booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during
items.statement:
Lemma booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) (e : GA_expr n),
    dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f <= max_booldist_during sq f e.

items.name: trace_boolish_le
items.statement:
Fixpoint trace_boolish_le {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ | Scalar _ => boolish_le (eval_expr sq e) d
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) d
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  end.

items.name: ExcNum
exc_of
exc_le
items.statement:
Definition exc_le (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a < exc_grade b)%nat \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a < exc_l1 b) \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a == exc_l1 b).

items.name: exc_pre
items.statement:
Definition exc_pre (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a <= exc_grade b)%nat /\ exc_l1 a <= exc_l1 b.

items.name: computes
items.statement:
Definition computes {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall m : Mask n, eval_expr sq e m == embed f m.

items.name: expr_size
items.statement:
Fixpoint expr_size {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ => 1
  | Scalar _ => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Mul e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Conv e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  end.

items.name: easy_under
items.statement:
Definition easy_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q)
  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f /\
    exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\
    trace_boolish_le sq e d.

items.name: hard_under
items.statement:
Definition hard_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q)
  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f ->
    ~ (exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\ trace_boolish_le sq e d).

items.name: exc_pre_refl
items.statement: Lemma exc_pre_refl : forall a, exc_pre a a.

items.name: exc_pre_trans
items.statement:
Lemma exc_pre_trans : forall a b c,
  exc_pre a b -> exc_pre b c -> exc_pre a c.

items.name: exc_score
items.statement:
Definition exc_score (E : ExcNum) : Q :=
  (inject_Z (Z.of_nat (exc_grade E))) + exc_l1 E.

items.name: proj_bool
items.statement: Parameter proj_bool : forall n, MV n -> Corner n -> bool.

items.name: represents
items.statement:
Definition represents {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall x : Corner n, proj_bool (eval_expr sq e) x = f x.

items.name: looks_hard
items.statement:
Definition looks_hard (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q) {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f /\
    ~ (exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\ trace_boolish_le sq e d).

items.name: trace_boolish_le_node_Mul

items.statement: Variable n : nat.

items.name: dag_op
items.statement:
Inductive dag_op : nat -> Type :=
  | DOpBasis  : forall {k}, Fin.t n -> dag_op k
  | DOpScalar : forall {k}, Q -> dag_op k
  | DOpAdd    : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k
  | DOpMul    : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k
  | DOpConv   : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k.

items.name: GA_dag
items.statement:
Inductive GA_dag : nat -> Type :=
  | DagNil  : GA_dag 0
  | DagSnoc : forall {k}, GA_dag k -> dag_op k -> GA_dag (S k).

items.name: dag_size
items.statement: Definition dag_size {k} (_ : GA_dag k) : nat := k.

items.name: eval_op
items.statement:
Definition eval_op (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k}
    (env : Fin.t k -> MV n) (op : dag_op k) : MV n :=
  match op with
  | DOpBasis _ i   => basis (mask_single i)
  | DOpScalar _ c  => constMV c
  | DOpAdd _ a b   => mv_add (env a) (env b)
  | DOpMul _ a b   => mv_gp sq (env a) (env b)
  | DOpConv _ a b  => mv_conv (env a) (env b)
  end.

items.name: eval_dag_env
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_dag_env (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    : Fin.t k -> MV n :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => fun i => Fin.case0 _ i
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      let prev := eval_dag_env sq d' in
      let v := eval_op sq prev op in
      fun i =>
        match i in Fin.t (S k') return (Fin.t k' -> MV n) -> MV n -> MV n with
        | Fin.F1 => fun _ newest => newest
        | Fin.FS j => fun old _ => old j
        end prev v
  end.

items.name: eval_dag
items.statement:
Definition eval_dag (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    (i : Fin.t k) : MV n :=
  eval_dag_env sq d i.

items.name: eval_dag_env_snoc_F1
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_env_snoc_F1 :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) (op : dag_op k),
    eval_dag_env sq (DagSnoc d op) Fin.F1
    = eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d) op.

items.name: eval_dag_env_snoc_FS
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_env_snoc_FS :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) (op : dag_op k)
         (j : Fin.t k),
    eval_dag_env sq (DagSnoc d op) (Fin.FS j)
    = eval_dag_env sq d j.

items.name: dag_max_l1
items.statement:
Fixpoint dag_max_l1 (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) : Q :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => 0
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      Qmax (dag_max_l1 sq d')
           (l1_norm (eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d') op))
  end.

items.name: dag_max_grade
items.statement:
Fixpoint dag_max_grade (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) : nat :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => 0%nat
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      Nat.max (dag_max_grade sq d')
              (max_grade (eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d') op))
  end.

items.name: dag_exc
eval_dag_l1_le_peak
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_l1_le_peak :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) (i : Fin.t k),
    l1_norm (eval_dag sq d i) <= dag_max_l1 sq d.

items.name: eval_dag_grade_le_peak
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_grade_le_peak :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) (i : Fin.t k),
    (max_grade (eval_dag sq d i) <= dag_max_grade sq d)%nat.

items.name: dag_max_l1_mono
items.statement:
Lemma dag_max_l1_mono :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) (op : dag_op k),
    dag_max_l1 sq d <= dag_max_l1 sq (DagSnoc d op).

items.name: dag_max_grade_mono

items.name: flatten
items.statement:
Fixpoint flatten (e : GA_expr n)
    : { k : nat & GA_dag (S k) * Fin.t (S k) }%type :=
  match e with
  | Basis i =>
      existT _ 0
        (DagSnoc DagNil (DOpBasis i), Fin.F1)

  | Scalar c =>
      existT _ 0
        (DagSnoc DagNil (DOpScalar c), Fin.F1)

  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpAdd r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                     
      

  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpMul r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                     
      

  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpConv r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                      
      
  end.

items.name: XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Definition XOR_explicit {n} : MV n :=
  mv_add (mv_scale (1#2) (basis mask_empty))
         (mv_scale (- neg1_pow n * (1#2)) (basis (Vector.const true n))).

items.name: eval_XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma eval_XOR_explicit : forall n (s : Corner n),
  eval (@XOR_explicit n) s == bQ (XOR_n_func s).

items.name: embed_XOR_eq_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma embed_XOR_eq_explicit : forall n (m : Mask n),
  embed (@XOR_n_func n) m == (@XOR_explicit n) m.

items.name: mask_empty_neq_full
items.statement:
Lemma mask_empty_neq_full : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> @mask_empty n <> Vector.const true n.

items.name: XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n mask_empty == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_full_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_full_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_other_zero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_other_zero : forall n (m : Mask n),
  m <> mask_empty ->
  m <> Vector.const true n ->
  @XOR_explicit n m == 0.

items.name: support_size_at_least_two
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_at_least_two :
  forall n (F : MV n) (a b : Mask n),
    a <> b -> ~(F a == 0) -> ~(F b == 0) ->
    (2 <= support_size F)%nat.

items.name: support_size_basis_general
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_basis_general : forall n (M : Mask n),
  support_size (basis M) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR_explicit_le
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR_explicit_le :
  forall n, (support_size (@XOR_explicit n) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint IP_raw (l : list Sign) : bool :=
  match l with
  | nil         => false
  | _ :: nil    => false                                    
  | x :: y :: rest =>
      xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (IP_raw rest)
  end.

items.name: IP_n_func
items.statement:
Definition IP_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  IP_raw (Vector.to_list c).

items.name: IP_n_func_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma IP_n_func_cons2 :
  forall n (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    @IP_n_func (S (S n)) (Vector.cons _ x _ (Vector.cons _ y _ c))
    = xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (@IP_n_func n c).

items.name: signed
items.statement: Definition signed (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: signed_xorb
items.statement: Lemma signed_xorb : forall a b, signed (xorb a b) == (signed a * signed b)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun a => (signed (f a) * chi' M a)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: bQ_via_signed
items.statement: Lemma bQ_via_signed : forall b, bQ b == ((1 - signed b) * (1#2))%Q.

items.name: AND_2
items.statement:
Definition AND_2 (c : Corner 2) : bool :=
  andb (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd c))
       (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c))).

items.name: signed_walsh_2
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh_2 (f : Corner 2 -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) : Q :=
  signed_walsh f (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ (Vector.nil _))).

items.name: prod_pairs_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint prod_pairs_raw (l : list bool) : Q :=
  match l with
  | []            => 1%Q
  | [_]           => 1%Q                                    
  | b1 :: b2 :: rest =>
      (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs_raw rest)%Q
  end.

items.name: prod_pairs
items.statement:
Definition prod_pairs (m : nat) (M : Mask (m + m)) : Q :=
  prod_pairs_raw (Vector.to_list M).

items.name: Sn_plus_Sn
items.statement: Lemma Sn_plus_Sn : forall m, S (S ((m + m)%nat)) = (S m + S m)%nat.

items.name: mask_cast
items.statement:
Definition mask_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1) : Mask n2 :=
  eq_rect n1 (Vector.t bool) M n2 H.

items.name: to_list_cast
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1),
  Vector.to_list (mask_cast H M) = Vector.to_list M.

items.name: prod_pairs_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_cons2 : forall m (b1 b2 : bool) (M : Mask (m + m)),
  prod_pairs (S m) (mask_cast (Sn_plus_Sn m)
    (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ M)))
  = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M)%Q.

items.name: vector_peel2
items.statement:
Lemma vector_peel2 : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v : Vector.t A (S (S n))),
  exists (a1 a2 : A) (v' : Vector.t A n),
    Vector.to_list v = a1 :: a2 :: Vector.to_list v'.

items.name: Sm_plus_Sm
items.statement: Lemma Sm_plus_Sm : forall m, (S m + S m)%nat = (S (S (m + m)%nat)).

items.name: mask_decompose2
items.statement:
Lemma mask_decompose2 : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  exists b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M''.

items.name: prod_pairs_unfold
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_unfold : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  forall b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M'' ->
    prod_pairs (S m) M = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M'')%Q.

items.name: inject_Z
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> a * b == a * c.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> b * a == c * a.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> a - c == b - c.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> c - a == c - b.

items.name: embed_via_signed_walsh
items.statement:
Lemma embed_via_signed_walsh : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n),
  embed f M == ((1 / pow2 n) * ((1#2) * (if mask_eq_dec M mask_empty then pow2 n else 0)
                - (1#2) * signed_walsh f M))%Q.

items.name: all_corners_2
signed_walsh_AND_2var
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_AND_2var : forall (b1 b2 : bool),
  signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 ==
    if b1 then (if b2 then (-2)%Q else (-2)%Q)
    else (if b2 then (-2)%Q else 2%Q).

items.name: all_corners_S
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_S : forall n,
  all_corners (S n)
  =
    map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos n c) (all_corners n)
 ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg n c) (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_SS
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS : forall n,
  all_corners (S (S n))
  =
     map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n).

items.name: chi'_cons2_factor
items.statement:
Lemma chi'_cons2_factor :
  forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n) (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    chi' (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
         (Vector.cons _ x  _ (Vector.cons _ y  _ c))
    ==
    ((if b1 then sQ x else 1%Q) *
     (if b2 then sQ y else 1%Q) *
     chi' m c)%Q.

items.name: to_list_inj
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_inj : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v1 v2 : Vector.t A n),
  Vector.to_list v1 = Vector.to_list v2 -> v1 = v2.

items.name: corner_cast
items.statement:
Definition corner_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1) : Corner n2 :=
  eq_rect n1 Corner c n2 H.

items.name: to_list_corner_cast
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_corner_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1),
  Vector.to_list (corner_cast H c) = Vector.to_list c.

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq : forall k x y : Q,
  k * (x + y) == k * x + k * y.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_l
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_l :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => k * f x) l) == k * sumQ (map f l).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq : forall k x y : Q,
  (x + y) * k == x * k + y * k.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_r :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) l) == (sumQ (map f l) * k)%Q.

items.name: chi_eq_chi'
items.statement:
Lemma chi_eq_chi' : forall n (m:Mask n) (c:Corner n),
  chi m c == chi' m c.

items.name: sumQ_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_flat_map :
  forall (A B : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> Q),
    sumQ (map f (flat_map g l))
    ==
    sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map f (g a))) l).

items.name: map_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma map_flat_map :
  forall (A B C : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> C),
    map f (flat_map g l) = flat_map (fun a => map f (g a)) l.

items.name: cons2
items.statement:
Definition cons2 {n} (c2 : Corner 2) (x : Corner n) : Corner (S (S n)) :=
  Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd c2) (S n)
    (Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c2)) n x).

items.name: all_corners_SS_flatmap
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS_flatmap :
  forall n,
    all_corners (S (S n)) =
      flat_map
        (fun c2 : Corner 2 =>
           map (fun x : Corner n => cons2 c2 x) (all_corners n))
        (all_corners 2).

items.name: signed_walsh_tensor2
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_tensor2 :
  forall n (g : Corner 2 -> bool) (h : Corner n -> bool)
         (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n),
    signed_walsh
      (fun a : Corner (S (S n)) =>
         xorb (g (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd a) _
                  (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd (Vector.tl a)) _ (Vector.nil _))))
              (h (Vector.tl (Vector.tl a))))
      (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
    ==
    (signed_walsh_2 g b1 b2 * signed_walsh h m)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_factored
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_factored : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == prod_pairs m M.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_magnitude
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_magnitude : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  exists s : bool, signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M 
                    == signed s * inject_Z (Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat m)).

items.name: pow2_injectZ
items.statement:
Lemma pow2_injectZ : forall n,
  pow2 n == inject_Z (2 ^ Z.of_nat n).

items.name: Zpow2_nat_eq_1
items.statement:
Lemma Zpow2_nat_eq_1 : forall n,
  Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat n) = 1%Z -> n = 0%nat.

items.name: embed_IP_all_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma embed_IP_all_nonzero : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  ~ (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == 0).

items.name: support_size_IP
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_IP : forall m,
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m))) = Nat.pow 2 (m + m).

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound
items.statement:
Theorem IP_formula_size_lower_bound :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m)%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight
items.statement:
Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m + m)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support
items.statement:
Lemma formula_size_lower_bound_from_support :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (support_size (embed f) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_k
items.statement:
Corollary formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_k :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) k,
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (k <= support_size (embed f))%nat ->
    (k <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2
items.statement:
Corollary formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2 :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) t,
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (Nat.pow 2 t <= support_size (embed f))%nat ->
    (t <= formula_size phi)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_full_support
items.statement:
Corollary formula_size_full_support :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    (formula_size phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: support_size_embed_XOR
items.statement:
Corollary support_size_embed_XOR :
  forall n,
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_via_full_support
items.statement:
Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_via_full_support :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m + m)%nat.

items.name: XOR_support_size_small
items.statement:
Corollary XOR_support_size_small :
  forall n,
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    (support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: full_support_implies_size_ge_n
items.statement:
Corollary full_support_implies_size_ge_n :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    (formula_size phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: occurs_var
items.statement:
Fixpoint occurs_var {n} (i : Fin.t n) (phi : BoolFormula n) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | BVar j     => i = j
  | BConst _   => False
  | BAnd p q   => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q
  | BOr  p q   => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q
  | BNot p     => occurs_var i p
  end.

items.name: length_filter_eq_Forall
items.statement:
Lemma length_filter_eq_Forall :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    length (List.filter p l) = length l ->
    List.Forall (fun x => p x = true) l.

items.name: full_support_all_masks_nz
items.statement:
Lemma full_support_all_masks_nz :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    forall m, List.In m (all_masks n) ->
      negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0) = true.

items.name: nz_bool_to_neq0
items.statement:
Lemma nz_bool_to_neq0 :
  forall q : Q,
    negb (Qeq_bool q 0) = true ->
    ~ q == 0.

items.name: full_support_all_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma full_support_all_nonzero :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    forall m, In m (all_masks n) -> ~(F m == 0).

items.name: eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs :
  forall n (phi : BoolFormula n) i,
    ~ occurs_var (n:=n) i phi ->
    forall c1 c2 : Corner n,
      (forall j, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) ->
      eval_bf phi c1 = eval_bf phi c2.
